meta.title: TBD MMO · Design wiki
meta.description: Public design wiki of a dark-fantasy MMO in early development: concept, world, races and game systems.

intro.lede: A sword-and-magic world where mana holds reality together, and every thriving city exists only because someone keeps paying for it.
intro.hero-line: Left untended, the land slides back into white desert.

stats.areaNote: island continent, the first world map
stats.racesNote: playable races, lore not written yet
stats.systemsNote: game systems in design: 6 drafts, 2 stubs

concept.title: Concept
concept.subtitle: The top-level vision
concept.p1: Dark, sword-and-magic fantasy, partly in the spirit of Lineage 2: civilization is a fragile, contested achievement rather than a stable backdrop.
concept.p2: Mana is the substance reality itself is made of. A city’s prosperity is upkeep, not a one-time unlock, and it visibly reverts toward barren wilderness if neglected.
concept.tbd1: The one-line pitch and the three to five core pillars that every feature must serve are still open.
concept.p4: A pillar is a promise: if a feature doesn’t serve at least one, it probably doesn’t belong.
concept.tbd2: What the player does second by second.
concept.tbd3: What a single sit-down looks like, from log-in to log-out.
concept.tbd4: What accrues across sessions and brings a player back tomorrow.

world.title: World
world.subtitle: Lore and setting, kept apart from mechanics
world.p1: Mana as the substance of reality: city cores, blooming land and desert reversion.
world.p2: A 33 × 24 km island with lakes, rivers, waterfalls and mountain ranges.
world.p3: Who holds power, and how a player meets, joins or opposes them.
world.p4: The few past events the present day actually refers to.

races.title: Races & Characters
races.subtitle: Who lives here
races.p1: Human, Elf, Dwarf and Orc. Their history, cultures and place in the world are not designed yet.
races.p2: Quest-givers, rivals and the voices of the world’s cities.

systems.title: Systems
systems.subtitle: How each mechanic should feel, and why
systems.p1: One shared mana layer under everything: a personal pool, monster mana cores, item upkeep, and the city core with its storage vaults.
systems.p2: Six primary attributes, the combat stats they feed, resources, and the order in which modifiers apply.
systems.p3: Hybrid tab-target and skill-shot casting. Locks can be broken, aimed shots are hit-or-miss, and allies never block your projectiles.
systems.p4: A non-combat passive tree, use-based weapon mastery, and crafting driven by Novice and Master stones.
systems.p5: PvP that grows out of the economy: stolen cargo, sheriffs and warrants, persistent PK points, tracking and outlaw refuges.
systems.p6: Finite resources, independent city economies, contracts, exploration, and technology unlocked by player discoveries.
systems.p7: Items, currency and trade. Not designed yet.
systems.p8: Grouping, guilds and communication. Not designed yet.

status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Where things stand
status.p: The game is in early development. This wiki shows the team’s current design notes: most of them are drafts that will change, and the open gaps are marked “Not designed yet”. It is updated as the design moves.
status.source-note: This site presents the team’s design notes; it is not a separate canon. When the notes change, the wiki is updated to match. Names marked as working labels are placeholders, not lore.
